description:
23 Miles Long Range: Traverse up to an impressive 23 miles on a single charge, powered by its 36V 10.5 AH big battery.

Front & Rear Suspension System: Front & rear dual suspension for a consistently smooth and comfortable journey across any terrain.

High Performance Motor: Equipped with 350W power rating brushless motor, it can reache speeds of up to 19 miles per hour.

Safety System: The scooter has dual braking and lighting system, which prioritizes your safety during stops and the bright front lights and red taillights enhance visibility for night rides.

Comfort-Driven Design: 8.5-inch honeycomb shock-absorbing solid tires with high elasticity and wears resistance.

Smart App Integration: Scooter seamlessly connect to your smartphone with the dedicated app.
